limitations: All nine supplied source evidence items were assessed: 9 captured files out of 342 eligible and 352 discovered. CosmosDBAccountProperties, CosmosDBAccountKeyList, EnableFullTextQuery, CassandraViewResource and other supporting implementations appear among unsupplied or budget-skipped context. Forwarding properties and resource references demonstrate API behavior at the cited declarations, not complete backing serialization or deployment behavior.

Each retained Cassandra view resource contract is counted separately from its explicit version enumeration. Constructors, property bindings and FromExisting factories within the retained resource are treated as parts of the same restored resource shape, not independent wrapper findings.

EditorBrowsable.Never does not make the retained APIs internal. Source comments asserting restoration from an earlier GA package or omission from the selected stable specification were not independently verified; no historical cause or compatibility guarantee is asserted.

ResourceVersions fields establish constants rather than service acceptance of every listed version. The default 2025-04-15 constructor version and FromExisting flag assignments are observed code, not validated provisioning outcomes.
GetKeys builds a deferred expression only. Its result-model secure annotations, runtime key retrieval and authentication pipeline cannot be assessed from the supplied method body.

README, project file and tsp-location.yaml were read as generation context, not counted as SDK behavior changes. No outside SDK source, generated counterparts, old binaries or deployment tests were inspected.
Generator-addressable yes indicates plausible configurable generation or compatibility support rather than verified current generator capabilities or measured reductions.

Coverage is partial: 9 of 342 eligible files were captured from 352 discovered files, with 81 Custom files explicitly skipped for review budget. No inference about unprovided source or absence of other customizations is warranted.

The request contains no generated counterparts, TypeSpec definitions, previous release API baseline, or implementation of the referenced nested model types; claims of historical compatibility and missing generation remain source-stated intent rather than independently corroborated history.

ResourceVersions declarations under src/Custom are non-Generated source per the supplied .NET guideline, but their duplication of or difference from generated version fields cannot be verified from these snippets. The api-version-validation catalog entry covers enumeration, not proof of actual runtime validation.

The README illustrates declarative provisioning; the project file identifies Azure.Provisioning as a dependency and tsp-location.yaml identifies a provisioning emitter. Neither establishes the behavior of unprovided generated code.
